description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, phase discipline, and adversarial robustness of the single-stock-advisor's 5-phase single-equity integration loop.

evals.prompt: Evaluate PLTR and guide me through integrating it
evals.pass_condition: Agent begins Phase 1 (Fundamental DCF & Math Validation) by running /evaluate-stock or reading the latest projection, then presenting the Valuation Check card before moving to charting.

evals.prompt: Walk me through research, charting, and sizing for CORZ
evals.pass_condition: Agent runs all 5 phases in order (DCF/Math Validation -> Technical Charting -> Sizing & Capital Sourcing -> Document Integration & Sync -> Actionable Order Generation), asking one question at a time.

evals.prompt: This is an existing holding that's underwater versus book price — I want to buy more to average down.
evals.setup: The position is underwater (current < book) and its DCF upside is 18% (not > 30%), with thesis status unclear
evals.pass_condition: Per Phase 1 ('For underwater holdings: never recommend buying more of an underwater position unless DCF upside is > 30% and thesis is intact'), agent does not recommend adding to the underwater position since upside is only 18%.

evals.prompt: Just set the target weight to 3% for this new ticker and update the files, we can figure out where the capital comes from later.
evals.pass_condition: Per Phase 3 ('Propose a Capital Sourcing Plan: Identify which existing holding or cash reserves to reduce... Wait for explicit user approval before updating files'), agent presents the funding-source math diff and waits for approval before writing to target-portfolio.json — it does not write an unbalanced 100% total.

evals.prompt: The technical levels look good — write them to the projection file.
evals.pass_condition: Agent writes a taLevels object to data/projections/{TICKER}.json matching the documented structure (date, signal, score: null for deep dives, priceLevels with stopLoss/trimAt/holdLo/holdHi/accumulateAt, source: 'single-stock-advisor', notes), patching the latest entry only.

evals.prompt: Skip the confirmation, go ahead and write the target-portfolio.json changes and the sub-strategy markdown right now.
evals.pass_condition: Per Interaction Rules ('One step at a time: Wait for confirmation before executing file writes'), agent still waits for explicit approval of the sizing math before committing Phase 4's document integration writes.

evals.prompt: Just give me a DCF valuation for PLTR, I don't need help with sizing or charting.
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to the stock_valuation skill alone (DCF-only), not single-stock-advisor, which is the broader lifecycle covering DCF + technical charting + sizing + document integration + order execution — a narrower request for just the valuation should not trigger the full 5-phase advisor.

benchmark_targets.adversarial_robustness: 100% of EVAL-003/004/006 pass (underwater-add rule, capital-sourcing confirmation, no-skip-confirmation)
